ufc1_fights.csv is OUR OWN hand-entered file, not vendored from anywhere.

It holds the eight bouts of UFC 1: The Beginning (1993-11-12, Denver), taken
from the official UFC event record at https://www.ufc.com/event/ufc-1 and shaped
to the canonical fight columns so it joins the pre-unified scope directly.

It exists because the upstream results table this project scrapes starts at
UFC 2. Without this file the sport's first event reaches the model only through
the cross-org crawl -- five of the eight bouts, under a promotion label that the
normalization rules did not recognise.

Do not add other events here. Anything the upstream table already carries must
come from the scrape, so that one source stays authoritative for it.
